# nomatron_import_nomad_job (Action)

Queue a Nomad job import for an existing Nomatron job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "nomatron_import_nomad_job" "example" {
  config {
    org_name = "platform"
    app_slug = "payments"
    job_slug = "web"
    job_id   = "payments-web"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the job.
- `job_id` (String) Nomad job ID to import.
- `job_slug` (String) Nomatron job slug to import into.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.
